name: Wireless plus Fiber bundle - 300Mbps and Premium 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: practical homeowner.
scripted_messages: Hello. I'm interested in bundling AT&T Fiber with a wireless line. The site shows Fiber 300Mbps for $35 a month for the first year. If I add one line on Premium 2.0, what would I pay monthly in total, and what happens after the first year?
Thanks. Is there a bundle discount on the wireless side too?
And is there an installation fee for Fiber?
Alright, that gives me what I need. You were friendly and thorough, thank you.
That's all for today. Have a good one, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 6: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 7: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
